description: Your month in the vault, for the wallet you signed in with: what you claimed in real units and USD, how many claims included the lock boost, where you stand among that month's claimers, your badges, and what the vault distributed to holders that month. This month so far by default. Read-only, same sign-in as get_my_vault.

month.description: "current" (this month so far, the default), "previous", or a month as YYYY-MM within the last 12 months.
